name: PostgreSQL Operations
description: Check that Postgres is up, look at connections, storage, and logs, and refuse destructive SQL unless the user explicitly allows it.

permissionsRequired.reason: Check Postgres status and a read-only query path on a configured server alias.
Run the same checks when Postgres is local.
Read a local Postgres config or migration.
Read logs from a local database process.

validation.rule: Availability, connections, storage, or logs were inspected before a repair, no DROP, TRUNCATE, or delete-without-where ran without explicit authority, and database availability was checked afterward.
